_comment: Expected test inventories and known-failing sets for the rocal-validate skill.
Everything here is a GATE, not documentation. If a number drifts, the skill fails
and names what moved. Update deliberately, in a reviewed commit, never to make a
red run go green.
tests/cpp_api/CMakeLists.txt registers tests conditionally. A missing dependency
SHRINKS the run instead of failing it, so '100% passed' on a short list is the
trap this gate exists to catch. Tiers mirror the if() blocks in that file.
These are INDEPENDENT flags, not a ladder. rocdecode_FOUND and rocjpeg_FOUND are
separate if() blocks nested inside the HIP block (CMakeLists.txt:251-270), so all
four HIP combinations below are legitimate. check_ctest.py composes the expected
set from --backend plus --rocdecode/--rocjpeg rather than picking a single rung.

totals._comment: Reference only - check_ctest.py computes the set, not these numbers.

disabled_in_cmake.dataloader: tests/cpp_api/CMakeLists.txt add_test commented out - non-functional with database
disabled_in_cmake.dataloader_tf: tests/cpp_api/CMakeLists.txt add_test commented out - non-functional with tf dataset

_comment: tests/pybind is NOT in the top-level build; configure it as its own project.
Its CMakeLists gates every add_test on EXISTS ${ROCM_PATH}/lib/amd/rocal, so when
pybind is not installed ctest prints 'No tests were found!!!' and EXITS 0.
(Verified: a project with no tests gives `ctest; echo $?` -> 0.) An exit-code-only
check passes a run that tested nothing. Treat zero discovered tests as a HARD FAIL.
pybind.coverage_caveat: These are import/smoke tests. 6/6 green means the module loads, not that it computes correctly.

_comment: tests/python_api sets no exit code anywhere, so the gate is parsed from the
image_comparison.py summary. Case names are normalised by stripping the trailing
'.png' and the '_host'/'_hip' backend suffix, because image_comparison.py reports
'Failing cases:' as golden filenames like 'Hue_rgb_host.png'.
MEASURED 2026-10-28 on a HIP machine and reproduced independently by the user.
These failures are KNOWN, NOT root-caused, and NOT accepted. The report repeats
that caveat every run so they do not quietly become permanent.

hip.failing_note: Count measured at 17/139 but the exact name set was not captured on 2026-10-28. The skill treats a null 'failing' list as UNPINNED: it gates on the total and on the failed count, reports the observed names, and offers to pin them.

audio._comment: Only runs when the build reports AUDIO_SUPPORT. audio_unit_test.py prints 'Number of FAILED tests: N'.
